description: This Java source file defines the class AndroidExternalApklibDependenciesManager, which manages external Maven dependencies for Android projects within the IntelliJ IDEA environment. It handles persistent storage of dependency information, including resolved artifact details and file paths, and provides methods to access and modify this data.

classes.name: AndroidExternalApklibDependenciesManager
classes.description: Main class managing external Maven dependencies for Android projects, including persistent state handling and dependency info storage.

classes.name: AndroidExternalApklibDependenciesManager.State
classes.description: Inner class representing the persistent state, containing maps for artifact file paths and resolved info.

classes.name: AndroidExternalApklibDependenciesManager.MavenDependencyInfo
classes.description: Inner class representing detailed information about a Maven dependency, including group ID, artifact ID, version, type, scope, path, and library name.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Retrieves the singleton instance of the manager for a given project.

methods.name: loadState
methods.description: Loads the provided state into the manager.

methods.name: getResolvedInfoForArtifact
methods.description: Fetches resolved Maven artifact info for a given Maven ID.

methods.name: getArtifactFilePath
methods.description: Retrieves the file path for a given Maven ID string.

methods.name: setResolvedInfoForArtifact
methods.description: Stores resolved Maven artifact info for a given Maven ID.

methods.description: Stores the file path for a given Maven ID.

methods.description: Creates a MavenDependencyInfo object from a MavenArtifact.
